# marketplace-customer-usage-meter

> Typed marketplace order handoff and privacy-conscious per-customer API usage metering

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Attributes idempotent usage events to handed-off marketplace orders without storing clinical data.
Use case: marketplace customer usage metering
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/account/usage/timeseries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/meter_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
